items.source: For example, the particular method to execute on an object may be discovered by a MethodResolver which then builds a MethodExecutor that executes that method, and the resolved MethodExecutor can be reused without needing to go back to the resolvers to discover the method again.
items.translation: 例如，要执行的对象上的特定方法可能由一个 `<code>MethodResolver`` 发现，然后构建一个 `<code>MethodExecutor`` 来执行该方法，且解析后的 `<code>MethodExecutor`` 可以重用，无需再次回到解析器去发现该方法的。

items.source: If a MethodExecutor becomes stale, it should throw an AccessException which signals to the infrastructure to go back to the resolvers to ask for a new one.
items.translation: 如果 `MethodExecutor` 变得过时，它应该抛出一个 AccessException，以通知基础设施返回到解析器处请求一个新的。

items.source: Execute a method in the specified context using the specified arguments.
items.translation: 使用指定的参数在指定的上下文中执行方法。

items.source: target - the target of the method invocation; may be null for static methods
items.translation: target - 方法调用的目标；对于`static`方法，可能为null

items.source: AccessException - if there is a problem executing the method or if this MethodExecutor has become stale
items.translation: AccessException - 如果执行方法时出现问题，或者此 MethodExecutor 已过期。

items.source: context - the evaluation context in which the method is being executed
items.translation: context - 方法正在执行的评估上下文

items.source: arguments - the arguments to the method; should match (in terms of number and type) whatever the method will need to run
items.translation: arguments - 方法的参数；其数量和数据类型必须与方法运行所需的要求相匹配。

items.source: the value returned from the method
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
安迪·克莱门特，萨姆·布拉南
